section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.4) describes the Body Mass Index assessment methodology. Participants self-reported their height and weight, which were used to calculate BMI in kg/m². The authors note that self-reported data are strongly correlated with measured data and are valid for identifying relationships in population studies.
